verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation of data retention windows or a redaction/deletion API for applicant PII. The cited items cover verification, webhooks, SDK customization, team access and data reuse, none of which addresses scrubbing or retention. The axis applies to an identity-verification service, so the absence of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can control what happens to collected identity data — documented retention windows and a redaction or deletion API that scrubs PII on demand
